scripts.check: bun run check:scripts && bun run check:e2e-helpers && turbo run lint typecheck test build
scripts.check:core: bun run check:scripts && bun run check:e2e-helpers && turbo run lint typecheck test build --filter=!@repo/web
scripts.ci:core: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run format:check && bun run check:product:core
scripts.ci:quality: bun run test:statistical && bun run test:browser-parity
scripts.test:compatibility: bun --filter @repo/server build && bun --filter @repo/server test:compatibility && bun --filter @repo/server soak:compatibility && bun --filter @repo/server smoke:build
